Welcome! I’m so glad you’re here.
Have you ever felt like you just didn’t quite fit in? Like maybe your quirks or passions made you stand out a little too much? Well, you’re not alone—and that’s exactly what we’re about to explore together.
Through the pages of You're Never Weird on the Internet, Felicia Day invites us into her world—a world where being different isn’t just accepted, it’s celebrated. Her story, told with a blend of humor and honesty, shows how the digital frontier can transform those moments of feeling out of place into powerful connections and creative breakthroughs.
We’ll follow her journey from the colorful chaos of childhood, to the unpredictable twists of the entertainment industry, all the way into the heart of online communities that thrive on individuality. Along the way, we’ll see how identity, creativity, and resilience can turn self-doubt into empowerment, and isolation into a genuine sense of belonging.
Felicia’s experiences remind us that embracing who we are—even the weirdest parts—can open doors we never imagined. So, as we set out on this adventure together, get ready to laugh, reflect, and maybe even see your own story in a brand new light. Let’s dive in and discover just how powerful it can be when we find our place in a connected, ever-evolving world.
